pages.text: Dark clouds gathered. Cut hay lay spread across the yard.
If rain soaked it, the hay could not be winter food for the sheep. Pipo wanted it all inside before the rain. He dusted off both hands.
Mr. Horse came striding over. "At a time like this, quick, quick! I will carry it all at once."
He hugged a mountain of hay. He could not see ahead at all.
Whoosh! The hay tumbled back across the yard.
Only Mr. Horse's tail poked out of the pile. "Ah... achoo!"
Pipo took just one armful. He could see clearly ahead.
He carried it with quick little steps. Hay stacked neatly in the shed; only one last armful remained outside.
Raindrops began to patter. All the hay was already in the shed. Mr. Horse flared his wet nose. "See? I told you to hurry!"
